questions.question: Write an essay on physiological and pathological factors affecting vase life of cut flowers. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Write an essay on physiological and pathological factors affecting vase life of cut
  • flowers. [U] / [CO2]
  • • Water stress and poor water uptake
  • • High respiration and transpiration rates
  • • Ethylene production and sensitivity
  • • Nutrient deficiency in vase solution
  • • Mechanical injury during harvest/transport
  • • Microbial contamination of vase water
  • • Improper temperature and humidity during storage
  • • Use of floral preservatives extends vase life
  • • Varietal differences and maturity stage affect longevity
  • • Fungal and bacterial infections cause early senescence

questions.question: Discuss the role of national and state-level agencies in promoting vegetable and flower cultivation in India. / [CO1] [10x1 = 10]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the role of national and state-level agencies in promoting vegetable and
  • flower cultivation in India. [U] / [CO1]
  • • National Horticulture Board (NHB): Infrastructure support, training, and subsidies.
  • • National Horticulture Mission (NHM): Promotes integrated development and farmer
  • training.
  • • APEDA: Encourages export of flowers and vegetables.
  • • ICAR & State Agricultural Universities: Conduct research and extension activities.
  • • State Departments of Agriculture/Horticulture: Implement schemes and distribute
  • quality planting materials.
  • • KVKs: Provide on-field demonstrations and capacity building.
  • • NABARD: Offers financial support for agri-horticultural enterprises.
  • • MIDH (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture): Focuses on protected
  • cultivation and post-harvest management.
  • • State Horticulture Missions: Promote region-specific crops and technologies.
  • • NGOs & Co-operatives: Help with marketing, awareness, and farmer organization.
  • (1X10=10)
